facts.big: met · moved · changed · got married · lost
facts.label: Passado: reencontro
facts.sub: Use met, moved, changed, got married e lost para contar o que aconteceu. Use ago com tempo. Pergunte How long ago did we last meet? e responda About five years ago.

facts.label: Reencontro

facts.label: Mudanças

pages.title: A lively café · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in a lively café in Chicago. Tables are full of friends and families. Mia stands at the door and looks around. A woman at the window waves at her. It is her old friend Alma. They hug for a long time.
“Mia! I can’t believe it. How long ago did we last meet?” says Alma. “About five years ago, at your party.” says Mia. “What happened since then? Did you move?” says Alma.
